A note on the room

Materials & image credits

The paintings are Randall Farmer’s original work. Their framed display images preserve their real, original frames; close-up views show the approved digital painting masters. No AI-generated versions of the paintings are used.

Gallery materials

  • The dark Victorian parquet floor and embroidered burgundy rug are a custom visual for the Reliquary footer, with a wide desktop crop and a closer mobile crop.
  • The Victorian burgundy-and-gold wall illustrations and dark copper Victorian ceiling banner were created specifically for the Reliquary, with separate responsive desktop and mobile variants. These are self-hosted decorative artwork.

The optimized wall, ceiling, floor, and exhibit placard images are bundled with the gallery, so the page does not need to fetch its decorative backgrounds from a third-party host.
